summary: Palomar Holdings filed an 8-K covering an updated corporate presentation and a press release on the successful completion of its June 1, 2026 reinsurance programs, including a new catastrophe bond (Torrey Pines Re Series 2026-1) providing $410 million of protection. The filing details $421 million of incremental limit for its Earthquake franchise, increasing total earthquake coverage to $3.92 billion, and a $130 million increase in Hawaii hurricane XOL coverage to $865 million. Per-occurrence retentions remain unchanged. This is a routine operational update on reinsurance procurement and guidance, not a special situation event.
